FilmCraft 
   Video editing, color and sound; an open-source, professional non-linear video editor, built in pure Rust. 
  An open-source, modern non-linear video editing workflow: native on macOS, Windows and Linux, and in the browser via WebAssembly. 
  By the ArtCraft team.
    FilmCraft on getartcraft.com   ·
   ArtCraft  ·
   All Crafting Apps 
   Apollo 11 - Tranquility : a three-minute documentary edit of NASA's 1969 launch, landing and moonwalk film, with subtitles from the mission transcript. Every frame in these screenshots comes from public-domain footage, decoded, composited and graded by FilmCraft's own code.  
> [!NOTE]
> **ArtCraft is a community of artists from all walks of life.** Digital, generative, music,
> games — if you make things, you're one of us. **[Come say hi on Discord](https://discord.gg/artcraft).**

FilmCraft is a professional non-linear editor: familiar panels, workspaces, tools and shortcuts, so your hands already know where everything is. Underneath, it is new from the bitstream up. The H.264, HEVC, ProRes and AAC codecs are our own, written in Rust from the public specifications. A GPU compositor works in linear light. Frame math runs on exact integer time, so edits never drift. And every action in the app is a command that an AI agent can drive as precisely as y

  ⭐  Help more people find Hypit and grow the community. Star this repo! 
## Hypit
Hypit gives AI agents (Claude Code, Codex...) a language and system to create video. Drop in a video, and your agent clones it as a complete workflow: footage, captions, B-roll and effects, all anchored to words instead of seconds.
**To be clear:** cloning a video is the fastest way in, not the only one. You can start from our templates, or just describe the video you want and your agent writes the workflow from scratch. Generation models are optional too: a workflow can compile captions, motion graphics and code-rendered visuals into a finished video without calling a generation model or incurring its service charges.
  SVML source on the left, with the corresponding video rendered live on the right.  
## Install once
```bash
npx skills add hypit-ai/hypit -g
```
This installs the Skill. On first use, your agent checks for the Hypit executable and helps prepare
it if needed. Your video project can live anywhere.
Hypit is free to use; your Coding Agent and model services have their own accounts and charges.
HypiHub is our recommended hosted model service. You can also use your own API or local models;
tell your agent the service name and API documentation so it can set up the appropriate connection.

itens.descricao_en: One-click character swap for videos: an open-source, local Higgsfield Genjutsu alternative built on ComfyUI and MiniMax H3, with FLUX.3 Klein relighting.
itens.readme:
# Openjutsu
An open-source, Genjutsu-style character and object swap for video. Drop a video and a character photo, press **Generate**, and the main person in the video is replaced by your character. Or change their hair or clothes, remove something, or put them somewhere else. The camera, cuts, motion and soundtrack stay. Everything runs on open weights on your own GPU: MiniMax H3 for the video, SAM 3.1 to track people, and Qwen3-VL 8B to describe the pictures and shots.
The app is a small Next.js front end over a ComfyUI workflow. It uses [`@comfyorg/sdk`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@comfyorg/sdk), following Comfy's [comfy-reshoot](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/comfy-reshoot) reference app.
https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2d8d763a-1764-49a6-9116-d6d1be661ff6
| Advanced: several people, pick who becomes who | Object swap: paint where it goes |
| --- | --- |
|   |   |
| **From picture: a new look and place from one picture** | **Post-processing: fix faces** |
|   |   |
**From picture → Relight: new light in the same pass**
## First visit: visual describer
The welcome page lets you choose the vision-language model that describes pictures and video frames and writes prompts. Qwen3-VL 8B INT8 remains the default; Qwen3-VL 4B FP8 and Gemma 4 E2B INT8 are smaller alternatives. Install a compatible single-file model including its vision weights in `ComfyUI/models/text_encoders`, then press **Refresh models**. Other installed models can be selected if they support image

Tell Claude Code or Codex "make a promo for my product". The agent captures your real pages, picks shots
from a library of tuned motion recipes, storyboards the film, animates it with

itens.descricao_en: 逆向一切视频：实拍口播、桌拍、AI 视频、3D、代码动效、混剪，逐镜拆出画面、花字、剪辑和声音是怎么做的，并给出复刻方案。Reverse-engineer any video, shot by shot.
itens.readme:
# rea-video
逆向一切视频。
实拍口播、桌拍、AI 视频、3D、代码动效、混剪都能拆， 
逐个镜头告诉你画面、花字、剪辑和声音是怎么做的，再告诉你怎么照着做一条。
中文 | [English](README_en.md) | [日本語](README_ja.md)
[ ](https://github.com/JuneYaooo/rea-video/stargazers)
左边是 TikTok 上的手机实拍原片，右边是别人用 AI 换了产品重做的版本。 
rea-video 判断：左边全部实拍，一个场景、两个机位就能拍完；右边全部 AI 生成，8 个镜头可以合并成 3 次生成。
## 能拆哪些视频
| 视频类型 | 常见例子 | 拆出什么 |
|---|---|---|
| 实拍 | 口播、桌拍、手持带货、vlog、探店 | 拍摄场次和机位，景别、运镜、布光（12 种方案附器材）、调色 |
| AI 视频 | 文生 / 图生视频、AI 短剧、AI MV | 判断依据，每镜反推的提示词，合并成几次生成、用哪个模型 |
| 数字人 | 人像被声音驱动说话、对口型 | 哪些镜头是数字人，需要的人像和音频 |
| 3D / 动画 | Blender / C4D 科普、产品动画、2D 动画、定格动画 | 用视频模型生成还是写 3D 代码渲染 |
| 代码 / 模板 | 文字动效、UI 演示、图表、PPT 式卡片 | 文字、版式、动效节奏，可以写成 Remotion 工程 |
| 录屏 / 截图 | 软件教程、网页演示 | 哪些是真实素材，复刻时要你自己录 |
| 混合 / 混剪 | AI 人物 + 代码界面 + 真实录屏，实拍口播 + 用本人出镜视频生成的 AI 带货段 | 每一镜分开判断，再按原时间线拼回 |
除了画面怎么做的，每条视频还会拆：
- 字幕和花字：每句字幕的起止时间（可导出 SRT / ASS），花字用什么颜色、描边、怎么出场
- 贴纸、表情包、画中画：放在哪、停多久
- 剪辑：在哪切、节奏多快、有没有卡节拍
- 声音：真人还是 AI 配音，配乐是 AI 做的还是曲库的、多少 BPM，音效落在哪一下
- 要你自己准备的素材：录屏、截图、产品图
## 快速开始
rea-video 是给 AI 助手用的。在 Claude Code、Codex 这类能运行命令的 agent 里说：
```text
安装 https://github.com/JuneYaooo/rea-video ，然后拆解这条视频：/path/to/video.mp4
```
agent 会自己装好命令行工具、读完拆解流程，然后从头跑完。电脑上需要有 ffmpeg 和 Python 3.10 以上。
跑完你会拿到：
- 一句话结论，比如「AI 视频 41% + 代码界面 59%，有 8 秒真实录屏，曲库配乐 122 BPM」
- 复刻方案，按实拍、AI 生成、代码分开写
- 完整报告 `report.html`：逐镜头截图、判断依据、提示词、拍法和声音拆解
配一个看视频的模型，Gemini 豆包都行，把接口地址和密钥告诉 agent 就行。配上之后实拍、AI、3D 分得更准，每个镜头还会反推出提示词。不配也能用，agent 自己能看图的话，会补看没把握的镜头。
## 案例
 混合片  · 19 秒 · 10 镜 
AI 人物对话 + 代码界面 + 8 秒真实录屏。5 个对话镜头被界面隔开，但同一个场景，一次生成就够。 
 视频  ·  报告 
 3D 科普片  · 6
